scope: synthetic-only; not evidence of actual electoral activity

assumption_details.paired_panel: Independent, representative binomial samples from same section-round natural p_B and baseline q_B; no source latent counts supplied to inference.
assumption_details.conditional_independence: Independent individual binomial draws in source counts, target references and calibration panels, given shared location effects.
assumption_details.optimistic_case: paired_exact_rate valid for D0 and H00 only
assumption_details.negative_control: biased behavioural panel invalidates p-panel representativeness and the nominal coverage guarantee.
